raw_comment: What stands out to me is how few areas are completely free from drought. For instance, Florida is the only state where most of the land isn’t affected. I’m curious about what’s causing this drought and whether it’s occurring beyond the U.S. Even though I live in Florida, I’ve noticed some effects, like lower humidity. I feel this particularly during my workouts, where I’ve been sweating much less compared to just two weeks ago. A possible title for this could be "United Drought of America".
